messages:
Maya: Quick sync — we need final X + LinkedIn posts for the product launch and webinar on Monday. Goal: drive signups + capture benchmark narrative. :rocket:
Josh: Got it. Do we have the hero image and final CTA?
Maya: hero image in drive but need the 16:9 crop. link: https://drive.google.com/launch-assets (preview in the file named 'hero-v3.png') :link:
Emily: Copy first pass below — feel free to tweak. I kept X shorter and LinkedIn expanded.
Maya: drop them, thx.
Emily: X (single tweet + thread):
```
Tweet 1: We built a lightweight inference path that cuts per-token costs by 30% while keeping p50 latency under 60ms. Join our webinar Monday to see the numbers + a live demo. https://redwood.ai/webinar #inference #mlinfra
Tweet 2 (thread): Why it matters: predictable latency = better UX, lower ops burden, and cheaper scale. We’ll share config, batching tips, and a realtime cost breakdown. RSVP: https://redwood.ai/webinar
```
LinkedIn (longer):
Quick note: hosting and private deployments shouldn’t be a tradeoff between cost and control. In our upcoming webinar we’ll show how a unified inference platform delivers consistent latency, lower unit economics, and tools for safe rollouts. Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar #LLM #inference #SaaS
Josh: Looks good. Can we add a short quote from product about the benchmark? e.g., 'Our internal benchmark shows a 30% cost reduction on typical customer workloads.'
Maya: Yes — sweeten the LinkedIn. Leo, can you draft the quote line?
Leo: Draft: 'Benchmarking on representative production traces, we observed ~30% cost reduction vs our previous baseline while preserving output quality.'
Maya: Nice. Add to LinkedIn and use this as an H2 in the blog excerpt.
Emily: Scheduling ask: Can we post X thread at 10:00am PT Mon, LinkedIn at 11:00am PT (after webinar reminder email goes out at 10:30)? Also want to run an engagement follow-up flow for high-engagers.
Maya: Yes. Follow-up flow: 1) DM top engagers on X within 24h with webinar recording + CTA to request a demo. 2) Nurture email for LinkedIn engagers if they clicked through.
Leo: DM template suggestion:
```
Hey <name> — thanks for the engagement on our launch post! We shared a webinar recording and would love to show how Redwood could cut inference costs in your stack. Interested in a 20-min demo? Cheers, Leo
```
Josh: I can add tracking UTM params and a short landing variant for ad clicks.
Maya: Perfect. Last asks: (1) final 16:9 hero from design by EOD today, (2) legal quick check on benchmark language (risk terms) — @Josh can you ping legal?
Josh: On it. I'll ping legal and upload the approved snippet to the drive.
scheduler-bot: Scheduled post created: channel=X account=@RedwoodAI, time=2026-03-23T17:00:00Z (10:00am PT). ID=sch_4821 :calendar:
Maya: Awesome. After scheduler confirms LinkedIn slot I'll lock the copy. Everyone thumbs-up when ready. :thumbsup:
Emily: 👍 ready once hero + legal OK.
Leo: 👍 will monitor for engagers and DM top 10.
Josh: ✅ pinged legal and started UTMs.
Maya: Closing — thanks team. I’ll post final copy here when legal signs off.
